one_line: This ad demonstrates how facial features are perceived holistically by showing how chin and eyelid adjustments visually alter the appearance of the nose and eyes.

hook.what_happens: A split-screen comparison of a woman's face is shown, challenging the viewer to identify the single change made.
hook.why_it_works: It creates immediate cognitive intrigue by presenting a visual puzzle about facial perception.

shots.description: Split-screen comparison of a woman's face before and after chin augmentation, with a slider revealing the change.
Zoomed-in view focusing on the nose and chin to clarify that the nose remained untouched while the chin was altered.
A pixel-difference heatmap overlay showing exactly which areas of the face changed, highlighting the chin area in yellow.
Side-by-side comparison with vertical measurement lines illustrating the spatial relationship between the nose and chin.
Second subject (older Black woman) demonstrating the visual effect of an upper blepharoplasty on eye perception.
Analysis of facial proportions divided into horizontal thirds (hairline to brow, brow to nose, nose to chin).
A 3D-style facial tracking mesh overlaid on the subject's face to emphasize holistic facial structure.
Text-based interactive prompt instructing the viewer to push their lower jaw forward to experience the optical illusion.
Final branding screen featuring a search bar mockup for 'Refina AI' over the split-screen face.

transcript.text: This is the same face twice. One thing on it was changed.
Almost everyone points at the nose. The nose isn't what changed. The chin is.
Your eye reads a feature against everything around it.
This is every pixel that changed. Almost none of them are on the nose.
It didn't shrink. The face caught up.
One. The nose and the chin are read as one line.
A chin that sits back leaves the nose out in front.
Bring the chin forward and the nose settles back. Same nose. Every time.
Two. Another face. The lid and the eye.
Skin resting on the lashes closes the eye beneath it.
Lift the hood and the eye reads open. The eye didn't grow. The cover moved.
Three. A face is read in thirds.
Hairline to brow. Brow to nose. Nose to chin.
Move one boundary and all three change.
None of this tells you what to do. It tells you why one feature can't answer it.
Faces are read whole. Not feature by feature.
Push your lower jaw forward, a few millimetres. Hold it.
Now look at your nose. Watch your nose get smaller.
You didn't touch your nose.
So the question was never one feature. It's what the whole face does when it moves.
A preview, not a promise. See it on your own face first.

narrative_arc: Introduce a visual puzzle showing a face with one hidden change.
Reveal that the chin changed, not the nose, introducing the concept of holistic facial perception.
Provide pixel-level proof of the change using a heatmap.
Explain the structural relationship between the nose and chin.
Provide a second example using upper blepharoplasty to show how eyelid changes affect eye perception.
Explain the rule of facial thirds.
Engage the viewer with an interactive physical test (jaw projection) to prove the optical illusion.
Introduce the Refina AI tool as a way to preview these holistic changes.

cta.what: Search for 'Refina AI' to preview holistic facial changes on your own face.

subjects: Unnamed older Black female subject (before/after upper blepharoplasty)
what_makes_it_work: The interactive 'Try it now' jaw-thrust exercise physically proves the optical illusion to the viewer.
High-quality, clinical-grade visual overlays and heatmaps establish scientific authority.
The counter-intuitive premise (changing the chin makes the nose look smaller) creates strong educational engagement.

animation_language_summary.how_things_enter: Elements fade and scale up slightly, or draw on as vector paths.
animation_language_summary.how_things_leave: Elements fade out quickly or are wiped away by the slider.
animation_language_summary.how_scenes_change: Hard cuts combined with continuous slider sweeps to maintain flow.
animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: The subject's face remains perfectly centered and aligned.
animation_language_summary.rhythm: Deliberate and educational, matching the clinical tone of the voiceover.

what_we_should_steal: Before-After Slider Sweep for interactive comparison demos
Dimension Callout Lines for technical and precise product callouts
Facial Wireframe Grid for high-tech AI aesthetic overlays
